items.verbatim: WEDC Tax Credit under the Business Development Tax Credit program, awarded 2022-05-05 to a recipient in City of Manitowoc, Manitowoc County. Industry: Utilities (NAICS 221310). Award amount: $150,000. Planned project cost: $11,450,950. Planned capital investment: $11,450,950. Planned job creation: 3
